research_notes: VERIFIED on official .gov.tr pages: age limit, %70 minimum, citizenship exclusion, benefit components, required documents, and the recurring application window text. NOT VERIFIED: the official Application Calendar page attaches NO YEAR to 'January 10 – February 20'. Third-party aggregators claim the 2026 cycle ran 10 Jan – 20 Feb 2026; that specific year-stamped claim was NOT confirmed on any official page and is deliberately excluded — deadline field left null rather than asserting a 2026 or 2027 date. Organizer legal entity (commonly attributed to YTB / Presidency for Turks Abroad) was not stated on the pages fetched, so organizer is recorded as the programme name plus its government domain. Relevance to ORYN: this is a destination-Türkiye scholarship for NON-Turkish students, i.e. it serves ORYN's international-applicant segment, not its Turkish students. DEDUP: plausible that an ORYN record already exists under 'Türkiye Bursları'.
